limitation.classifier_unavailable.title: One of our checks did not run
limitation.classifier_unavailable.detail: The other checks did run, and this result is built on what they found.

limitation.no_public_suffix_match.title: We could not tell who owns it
limitation.no_public_suffix_match.detail: The ending of {host} is not one we recognise, so the owner is less certain.

limitation.offline_no_reputation.title: We did not ask anyone else
limitation.offline_no_reputation.detail: This check ran on your phone alone, against our own rules. No outside service was consulted.

limitation.payload_not_understood.title: We did not recognise this format
limitation.payload_not_understood.detail: We show the content as plain text and open nothing.

limitation.redirect_not_expanded.title: We did not follow the short link
limitation.redirect_not_expanded.detail: Where {service} sends you is still unknown. You can ask us to follow it for you.

limitation.redirect_partial.title: We only got part of the way
limitation.redirect_partial.detail: Following stopped after {hopCount} steps, so the last address is still unknown.

limitation.redirect_resolution_failed.title: We could not follow the link
limitation.redirect_resolution_failed.detail: Following the link stopped because {reason}, so only the scanned address was checked.

limitation.rules_stale.title: Our rules may be out of date
limitation.rules_stale.detail: Our rules were last updated {ageDays} days ago, so very new threats may be missing.

limitation.rules_unavailable.title: Our threat list did not load
limitation.rules_unavailable.detail: We still read the address itself, but we could not compare it against known threats.

online.disclosure.title: Before you continue
online.disclosure.detail: This link is sent to our own server. Our server visits it and follows where it goes. Your phone never touches it.

online.error.title: The link could not be checked
online.error.detail: Something went wrong on our side. Your phone did not contact the link. You can try again.

online.expand_heading.title: Check where this link really goes

online.outcome_incomplete.title: Could not finish expanding this link
online.outcome_incomplete.detail: Your device still did not contact the link. See what could not be determined below.

online.outcome_max_hops.title: Stopped: too many redirects
online.outcome_max_hops.detail: This link was judged untrusted because it kept redirecting past the safe limit of 5 hops.

online.outcome_resolved.title: Followed to the final destination
online.outcome_resolved.detail: We followed the redirects for you. This does not mean the destination is safe - read the findings below.

online.resolving.title: Checking where it goes…
online.resolving.detail: Your phone is not contacting the link.

payload.app_deep_link.title: Opens an app, not a page
payload.app_deep_link.detail: It starts with {scheme}, which hands the code to an app on your phone.

payload.binary_content.title: Not readable text
payload.binary_content.detail: The code holds data rather than words. Nothing is opened or run.

payload.calendar_event.title: A calendar entry
payload.calendar_event.detail: The code adds "{summary}" to your calendar. Check the time and details first.

payload.contact_card.title: A contact card
payload.contact_card.detail: The code adds {name} to your contacts. Check the details before you save them.

payload.crypto_address.title: A cryptocurrency address
payload.crypto_address.detail: This asks for a payment in {currency}. Payments like this cannot be reversed.

payload.email_address.title: An email address
payload.email_address.detail: The code holds {address}. Nothing is sent unless you write and send it yourself.

payload.empty.title: Nothing in the code
payload.empty.detail: The code is empty. Try scanning it again.

payload.geo_location.title: A place on the map
payload.geo_location.detail: The code points at {latitude}, {longitude}. Opening it shows that spot in a map app.

payload.not_a_url.title: Not a web address
payload.not_a_url.detail: This code holds text rather than a link, so there is nothing to open.

payload.otp_secret.title: A login-code key
payload.otp_secret.detail: This sets up the codes that protect an account at {issuer}. Only scan it if you started the setup.

payload.phone_number.title: A phone number
payload.phone_number.detail: The code holds {number}. Check the number before you call it.

payload.premium_rate_number.title: A number that may cost extra
payload.premium_rate_number.detail: Calling or texting {number} can be charged at a higher rate. Check the price first.

payload.sms_message.title: Writes a text message
payload.sms_message.detail: This prepares a message to {number}. Read who it goes to and what it says before sending.

payload.wifi_hidden_network.title: A hidden Wi‑Fi network
payload.wifi_hidden_network.detail: {ssid} does not show up in the list of networks. Hidden is not the same as safer.

payload.wifi_network.title: Joins a Wi‑Fi network
payload.wifi_network.detail: This connects you to {ssid}, secured with {security}. Make sure it is the network you expect.

payload.wifi_open_network.title: An open Wi‑Fi network
payload.wifi_open_network.detail: {ssid} has no password, so others nearby can see what you send.

redirect.chained_shorteners.title: Several shorteners in a row
redirect.chained_shorteners.detail: The link passes through {count} shortening services. Stacking shorteners hides the destination and is rare in legitimate links.

redirect.cross_domain.title: Ends on a different domain
redirect.cross_domain.detail: The link starts on {fromDomain} but ends on {toDomain}. A different owner controls the page you would actually reach.

redirect.downgrade_to_http.title: Falls back to an unencrypted connection
redirect.downgrade_to_http.detail: The chain moves from an encrypted connection to an unencrypted one at {host}. Anything sent there can be read or altered on the way.

redirect.excessive_hops.title: Unusually long redirect chain
redirect.excessive_hops.detail: The link redirects {hopCount} times. Chains this long are uncommon for ordinary links and are often used to obscure where you end up.

redirect.loop.title: Redirects in a circle
redirect.loop.detail: The chain returns to an address it had already visited at {host}, so it never settles on a destination.

redirect.meta_refresh.title: Redirects using page content
redirect.meta_refresh.detail: The page at {host} redirects using its own content instead of a normal server redirect. This is sometimes used to avoid automated checks.

redirect.multiple_hops.title: Passes through several addresses
redirect.multiple_hops.detail: The link redirects {hopCount} times before arriving. Extra steps make the destination harder to predict.

ui.camera_denied.title: Camera access is turned off
ui.camera_denied.detail: You can still choose a photo or paste a link.

ui.camera_missing.title: No camera on this device
ui.camera_missing.detail: Choose a photo or paste a link instead.

ui.camera_problem.title: The camera would not start
ui.camera_problem.detail: Close other apps using the camera, or choose a photo instead.

ui.credential_note.title: The text before @ is not the destination.
ui.credential_note.detail: Your browser goes to the name after @.

ui.follow_links.title: Look up short links
ui.follow_links.detail: Short links hide where they go. With this on, our own server can follow one and tell you where it lands. Your phone never touches the link either way.

ui.how_address.title: The web address
ui.how_address.detail: 26 checks. Is the real name at the end instead of the start? Is one letter borrowed from another alphabet? Are there characters you cannot see?

ui.how_content.title: What the code really is
ui.how_content.detail: 16 checks. A QR code is not always a link. It can be a text message that costs money, a wifi network, or a key to your login.

ui.how_redirect.title: Where it sends you next
ui.how_redirect.detail: 7 checks. Short links hide their destination. Some hop between sites, or stop protecting you along the way.

ui.limitations.title: What this check could not tell you

ui.no_code_found.title: No QR code in that picture
ui.no_code_found.detail: Try a sharper photo, or paste the link instead.

ui.offline_redirect_limitation.title: Where this short link ends up is still unknown
ui.offline_redirect_limitation.detail: Turn on "Look up short links" in Settings to find out, without your phone touching it.

ui.open_blocked.title: Opening is blocked
ui.open_blocked.detail: This code cannot be opened from here.

ui.possible_redirect_warning.title: Possibly a redirect
ui.possible_redirect_warning.detail: This may send you to a different final destination. That does not mean the link is safe or unsafe by itself.

ui.privacy_note.title: Privacy
ui.privacy_note.detail: No account, no tracking, no history. The check runs on your phone.

ui.reassurance.title: Nothing opens until you say so
ui.reassurance.detail: The check runs on your phone. QRavn never visits the link.

ui.scan_aim.title: Point your camera at the code

ui.tagline.title: Check a QR code before you open it

url.bidi_control_characters.title: Text that can flip direction
url.bidi_control_characters.detail: Hidden characters can reverse part of the address on screen, so what you read is not what opens.

url.brand_in_path.title: A known name after the address
url.brand_in_path.detail: {brand} appears after the address, where the site owner writes whatever they like.

url.brand_in_subdomain.title: A known name in the wrong place
url.brand_in_subdomain.detail: {brand} appears in the address, but the site is owned by {registrableDomain}. Anyone can put a name there.

url.confusable_host.title: Letters chosen to look like others
url.confusable_host.detail: {host} uses characters that imitate {skeleton}. That is how a fake name passes for a real one.

url.control_characters.title: Invisible characters
url.control_characters.detail: The text contains characters you cannot see. They can hide part of the address.

url.credentials_in_authority.title: Hidden real address
url.credentials_in_authority.detail: The part before @ is not where this goes. It opens {host}, not {username}.

url.data_scheme.title: A page carried inside the code
url.data_scheme.detail: The content is packed into the code itself, so there is no website behind it to check.

url.encoded_characters_in_host.title: The name is written in code
url.encoded_characters_in_host.detail: Parts of the name are written as % codes instead of letters, which hides what it really says.

url.excessive_length.title: Very long address
url.excessive_length.detail: It runs to {length} characters, so the part that matters is easy to miss.

url.excessive_subdomains.title: A long stack of names
url.excessive_subdomains.detail: There are {count} names in front of the real one, which pushes the part that matters out of sight.

url.file_scheme.title: Points at a file on the device
url.file_scheme.detail: This is not a website. It points into your phone or computer.

url.hyphenated_brand_domain.title: A known name with something added
url.hyphenated_brand_domain.detail: {registrableDomain} puts extra words around {brand}. Imitations are usually built this way.

url.insecure_scheme.title: Not a protected connection
url.insecure_scheme.detail: This uses http, not https. Anything you type can be read or changed on the way.

url.ip_literal_host.title: A number instead of a name
url.ip_literal_host.detail: This goes to {host}, a raw address with no name behind it. Real companies use names.

url.javascript_scheme.title: This runs code, not a page
url.javascript_scheme.detail: Opening it would run instructions on your phone. A QR code has no reason to do that.

url.known_malicious.title: Matches a known bad address
url.known_malicious.detail: This address is on our list of known threats, matched by rule {ruleId}.

url.mixed_script_host.title: Letters from several alphabets
url.mixed_script_host.detail: {host} mixes {scripts}. Letters that look identical can come from different alphabets.

url.nested_url_in_query.title: Another address inside this one
url.nested_url_in_query.detail: A second address, {nestedHost}, is carried inside this link. That is a common way to pass you on.

url.no_registrable_domain.title: No owner name to read
url.no_registrable_domain.detail: We could not work out who owns {host}, so there is nothing to recognise.

url.non_standard_port.title: Unusual door number
url.non_standard_port.detail: The address asks for port {port}. Ordinary websites do not need one.

url.open_redirect_parameter.title: Built to send you onward
url.open_redirect_parameter.detail: The link carries a {parameter} value, which usually means it hands you to somewhere else.

url.possible_shortener.title: Looks like a short link
url.possible_shortener.detail: {host} has the shape of a forwarding service, though it is not one we know by name.

url.punycode_host.title: Special letters in the name
url.punycode_host.detail: On screen it shows {unicodeHost}, but the real name is {punycodeHost}. Norwegian names use this too, so read it closely.

url.shortener.title: A short link that hides the rest
url.shortener.detail: {service} forwards you somewhere else, and the code alone does not say where.

url.suspicious_tld.title: An ending seen often in scams
url.suspicious_tld.detail: Addresses ending in {tld} turn up in fraud more than most. On its own it proves nothing.

url.unknown_scheme.title: Not an ordinary web link
url.unknown_scheme.detail: It starts with {scheme}, which opens an app or starts an action instead of a page.

verdict.insufficient_evidence.title: Insufficient evidence
verdict.insufficient_evidence.detail: We cannot say enough about the content or final destination. That does not mean it is safe.

verdict.known_malicious.title: Known malicious
verdict.known_malicious.detail: We found a concrete match in threat data or rules. Do not open the link without a specific reason.

verdict.no_known_threat_found.title: No known threat found
verdict.no_known_threat_found.detail: We found no known threats in this check. This is not a guarantee that the content is safe.

verdict.suspicious.title: Suspicious
verdict.suspicious.detail: We found signs often used in scams or misleading links. Read the findings before continuing.
